decision: Review the bounded diagnosis and smallest frontend proposal; no optimization implemented

rankedFindings.observed: After the score is decoded, current-route visibility takes another 6728.7 ms cold and 2729.8 ms warm. Within that period, first route-source submission to current visibility is 3519.9/1298.7 ms. Each sample submits all nine sources three times: 27 setData calls, including three writes of the same selected-route key with four features.
rankedFindings.hypothesis: The combined source-update effect resubmits unchanged route data when optional layer data changes. Extra worker processing may prolong readiness under host pressure. Payload equality and the counterfactual latency saving were not measured.
rankedFindings.smallestExperiment: After review and on a quieter host, record route-data object identity and worker source jobs, then compare one cold/warm pair with route source writes isolated from optional layer updates. Keep all other conditions constant.
rankedFindings.proposedFix: Split the source-update effect so route-derived sources update only when their route data or map/source instance changes; optional lamp, feedback and POI updates write their own sources. Preserve render keys, cancellation, retries, fitting and all evidence.
rankedFindings.price: Zero-pipeline frontend work plus targeted regression checks; no data change, dependency or deployment. Benefit unproven until the comparison.

rankedFindings.observed: Route source publication is gated by the map load callback. Map publication to load is 2321.5 ms cold / 1271.3 ms warm. First basemap-loaded observation is 6781.6/1990.5 ms, current selected route 10317.5/3291.0 ms. These periods overlap worker work and are not additive CPU costs.
rankedFindings.hypothesis: Basemap/style initialization delays route source publication. Tile transport, image decode, GPU/software rendering and host scheduling are not separately identified.
rankedFindings.smallestExperiment: Only if still material after the first fix is reviewed: controlled raster-delay versus normal raster timing while observing style readiness and route publication. Do not infer the basemap is the sole cause.
rankedFindings.price: Zero-pipeline diagnostic/frontend work if subsequently approved; no implementation now.

rankedFindings.observed: Navigation to first data fetch is 2628.5 ms cold / 285.9 ms warm. Loopback request to first HTML byte is 911.9/24.1 ms. Cold script responses extend from approximately 1002.5 to 3905.9 ms, including a 964039-byte decoded MapLibre-containing chunk; warm script resources are browser cache hits.
rankedFindings.hypothesis: Browser/server cache state, paging, script evaluation and initialization contribute. Without a flushed V8 trace or server spans, pure server execution and script compile/evaluation costs remain unresolved.
rankedFindings.smallestExperiment: Repair diagnostic trace flushing, discard detached worker sessions and verify early worker request coverage; repeat one pair on a quieter host. Add bounded server spans only if loopback TTFB remains high.
rankedFindings.price: Zero-pipeline diagnostics. No speculative server or bundling change proposed.

rankedFindings.observed: First data fetch to score-ready is 960.3/275.3 ms. The score body is 274882 encoded bytes and 5236013 decoded bytes. Its native body/decode/parse interval is 452.8/117.1 ms, with 95.5/87.2 ms remaining after ResourceTiming responseEnd. Geometry body/decode/parse is 12.1/5.5 ms. Local score prefix and score shard gzip probes return 404 before plain JSON succeeds, adding 192.7/114.9 ms on the score path.
rankedFindings.hypothesis: Native parse/allocation may contribute to the score residual, but residual time includes scheduling; it is not a pure parse measurement. Local missing gzip siblings do not prove a production packaging problem.
rankedFindings.smallestExperiment: Obtain native parse/decompression and server timing attribution before considering payload changes; verify the intended served artifact layout separately.
rankedFindings.price: Zero-pipeline diagnostic work. Any artifact repartitioning, generation or data rewrite is separately gated and not proposed for this repair.

hostConfounder: All 15 valid CPU samples show 100%; available memory ranges 707-1377 MiB and page input 1441-17792 pages/sec. Paging includes demand reads and does not establish that hardware alone is responsible. One pair cannot estimate variance or causality; additional samples stopped under the contract.
measurementCorrections: Prefer browser timeline route observations of 10317.5/3291.0 ms over outer harness wall observations of 11123/4499 ms; the latter also include CDP scheduling and polling.
Native body-read/decompression/parse remain a composite measurement. No pure parsing or decompression CPU claim.
Trace export has zero events and worker transfer capture is incomplete. Those are diagnostic gaps, not successful coverage.
Warm observed completed encoded bytes are zero for captured cache hits; this is not zero whole-app traffic. Four 404 responses and worker transfers have incomplete completion accounting.
First basemap-loaded milestone can precede later refit tile requests; the screenshot bracket separately confirms basemapLoaded and four current-route features at capture.

M12BudgetProposal.status: Proposed for review; not agreed, validated or satisfied by these pressure-limited samples
M12BudgetProposal.controlledLocalConditions: Same installed production build, postal 018956 and 390x844 viewport; no artificial throttling; new browser context/cache for cold, same context with re-navigation for warm, app module state reset, service worker bypassed. Start only after owner-arranged headroom: at least 2 GiB available, idle CPU below 20% and page input below 100/sec over 30 seconds. These are proposed screening conditions, not a hardware diagnosis.

latency.start: Navigation Performance timeOrigin for the shared postal URL
latency.textEnd: First visible four-metric summary for the current postal; page observation bounded by sampling interval
latency.routeEnd: Current render_key features in the unobscured viewport, source loaded, camera settled; confirm matching inspected screenshot/count bracket
latency.aggregation: Report every sample and median separately by profile; no p95 claim from up to three pairs

transfer.window: Navigation start through current selected-route visibility, unique observed completed requests, HTTP encoded bytes
transfer.scope: Provisional regression guardrails for explicitly observed request classes. Worker modules, imports and failed-response overhead must be fully captured before adopting a whole-app or warm-transfer budget.

M12BudgetProposal.realDeviceAcceptance: Still open. Select a physical phone and document actual available memory, browser, GPU and network; use worker-inclusive transfer accounting and reviewed latency budgets. The controlled local targets are design proposals, not a representative phone SLA or release approval.

nextDecision: Approve or reject the narrow route-source update separation and one controlled comparison after the telemetry gaps/headroom are addressed. No product fix was implemented in this diagnosis.
ownerAction: Arrange a quieter session or a suitable machine with the existing toolchain before the next measurement. The agent did not close unrelated applications, alter system settings, install anything or repeat the pressure-limited benchmark.
